items.reason: The new add_members action calls group.add for every supplied username without checking membership or wrapping the batch in a transaction (app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:71–77). Group#add unconditionally pushes the user (app/models/group.rb:272–273), conflicting with the unique membership index (db/migrate/20130416004933_group_users.rb:9); an existing member therefore causes an exception after earlier additions have persisted.

The changed endpoint passes the integer limit directly into the query and serializes its results without bounds checks (app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22–29), allowing oversized responses and PostgreSQL errors for negative limits. Visible groups are accessible anonymously (lib/guardian.rb:120–121); although automatic groups already accepted unchecked limits, this PR extends that behavior to nonautomatic groups.
